subject: Intro: Emi Oyler (SWE) — scheduling and next steps
messages:
From: Sara Patel <s.patel@talentreach.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Emi Oyler <emi.oyler@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Oct 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Emi Oyler — strong SWE candidate (resume attached)
Attachments: Emi_Oyler_Resume.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Hi Mina,

Quick intro — I work with TalentReach Partners; Emi is an experienced frontend/back-end SWE (React + Go) who is exploring roles with product-led AI companies. Emi is actively interviewing and is available for interviews next week.

Highlights:
- 5 years full-stack experience (React, TypeScript, Go)
- Recent work: shipping privacy-conscious telemetry pipeline at a small SaaS startup
- Open to hybrid/remote within US; US citizen

Emi — I’ve included Mina (hiring lead at Redwood) to coordinate a first technical screen. Emi’s availability (PST): Mon 10/13 9–11am, Tue 10/14 1–4pm, Wed 10/15 9–12pm. Emi prefers a single 45-min technical loop with one systems question + repo/architecture discussion.

Next steps: Mina — can you confirm if a 45-min loop with one frontend-heavy interviewer + one backend systems pair would work? Also flag any must-have topics.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Patel | Senior Partner, TalentReach Partners
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <s.patel@talentreach.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Oct 2025 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Emi Oyler — strong SWE candidate (resume attached)

Thanks Sara — and hi Emi, welcome.

This looks promising. We prefer a 45-min loop: 30 min technical + 15 min culture/team fit. Marcus (hiring manager) and Evelyn (senior engineer) will be on the loop. Can you confirm Emi’s compensation expectations and whether Emi is interviewing elsewhere close to an offer? We typically ask for a rough range to align on level.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Mon 10/13 9:30–10:15
- Tue 10/14 1:30–2:15
- Wed 10/15 10:00–10:45

If any of these work for Emi, we’ll send a calendar invite with a short prep note and a quick repo link request.

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad | Talent Acquisition Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Patel <s.patel@talentreach.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Emi Oyler <emi.oyler@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Emi Oyler — strong SWE candidate (resume attached)

Hi Mina — Emi asked me to share the following:

- Compensation expectation: ~ $160k–$180k total comp (open to banding based on title/RSU).
- Emi is in final conversations with another company but no offers yet; would prefer to interview this week if possible.

Emi confirmed Tue 10/14 1:30–2:15 PDT works best. Emi also shared a short portfolio link (I saved to a text file for calendar): https://portfolio.example.com/emi-oyler (see attached Emi_Oyler_Portfolio_Link.txt).

Let me know if you want any additional context.

—Sara
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <s.patel@talentreach.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Calendar invite: Emi Oyler — 45-min technical loop (Tue 10/14 1:30pm PDT)
Attachments: Interview_Prep.docx (stub)

Team — per Sara/Emi, we have a confirmed slot: Tue 10/14 13:30–14:15 PDT. I’ll book a virtual room and send an agenda.

Agenda (45 min):
- 5 min quick intros / context on role
- 25 min systems + code discussion (backend scaling + API design) — Marcus leads
- 10 min frontend/UX tradeoffs + code reading — Evelyn leads
- 5 min candidate Q&A / next steps

Prep notes in the invite: please avoid whiteboard algos; focus on system design, API decisions, and telemetry design for privacy-preserving instrumentation. Emi will have their laptop and a small sample app in the portfolio.

Also CC’ing People Ops (stephanie) for calibration on level/range — stephanie, FYI Emi’s stated range is $160k–$180k.

Thanks — Mina
From: Emi Oyler <emi.oyler@gmail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <s.patel@talentreach.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 12:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Calendar invite: Emi Oyler — 45-min technical loop (Tue 10/14 1:30pm PDT)
Attachments: Emi_Oyler_Portfolio_Link.txt (text)

Hi Mina, Marcus, Evelyn — looking forward to the chat in an hour. I attached my portfolio link and a quick note on a recent telemetry component I owned (two bullets).

Quick note on timezone: I’m remote in Seattle (PDT). If it helps, I can share a short recording of the app flow ahead of time — happy to do that if you prefer less live screen time.

See you soon,
Emi
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <s.patel@talentreach.com>, Emi Oyler <emi.oyler@gmail.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Oct 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Emi Oyler — feedback from 10/14 loop

Summary from interview (10/14):
- Interviewers: Marcus (systems), Evelyn (frontend/code read)
- Candidate: Emi Oyler — strong practical engineer, good systems sense, clear tradeoff thinking

Scores (out of 5):
- Problem solving: 4
- System design: 4
- Frontend code quality: 4
- Communication: 5

Notes:
- Marcus: liked the API partitioning proposal; candidate showed good familiarity with telemetry cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Me: Emi navigated the repo excerpt well, suggested incremental refactor, and called out backwards compatibility risks.
- Potential concern: limited exposure to large-scale distributed write-heavy systems; would be a 3->4 growth area.

Comp: Emi reiterated target band of $160k–$180k. Recommended: move to second-round on-site (half day) with a backend deep-dive + culture match. If we want to conserve interview cycles, a short backend take-home could substitute.

Recommendation: Marcus — if you’re comfortable with growth area, I’d greenlight next round. cc: People Ops for early band check.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Senior Staff Engineer, Redwood Inference
